rows: - 13 Nov, #78 folded into #80 (sections D to H). Audit of every unticked box of #78 against the `dev` tree by five read-only readers (one per phase group, about 170 s, 430 k subagent tokens): done already: `remote-chat-agent-speech` and `-host` crates, the structured Tamil judge and its landing, the nested context-file sizes; obsolete (the self-hosted runner and push gate are gone, the owner dropped the key-expiry watch, the dev to main merge and the adb grant): the gate's disk, cargo-lock and stop-early items, the `RUNNER_TAG_*` variables, the credential-expiry item, the replayed-nothing run reading (those runs lived in the old repository); open: the rest, carried over as boxes. Finding: `track-contracts.yml` and the other native `schedule:` workflows never fire until `dev` is the default branch; the tracker box says to use the `[track t3 orca]` marker or a dispatch on `dev`. #78 is closed with a pointer.
